summary: Import thunk for the Win32 AVI API AVIStreamRelease. Forwarded through the import address table: reads the __imp_AVIStreamRelease pointer at 0x0059E054 and tail-calls the imported function with the single PAVISTREAM argument, returning its ULONG result unchanged.

operations.description: Tail-call the imported AVIStreamRelease through the IAT pointer __imp_AVIStreamRelease (global 0x0059E054, read), passing pavi through.
Return the imported function's result directly; the thunk adds no computation of its own.

unresolved: Called from AVIStreamCleanup (0x0045BEA0); the game's AVI-stream usage pattern that leads to this release is not in evidence here.
The __imp_AVIStreamRelease IAT slot is resolved at load time against avifil32.dll; the actual library implementation is outside this binary.
